prompt: Create a hyper-detailed vertical sci-fi fantasy character lineup showing exactly 3 elegant android empresses standing full-body in a futuristic laboratory, each with porcelain anime-style faces, very long flowing silver-white hair, slender bodies, calm expression, and ornate biomechanical gowns. Arrange them evenly from left to right, facing forward in a symmetrical fashion: 1) left empress in reflective chrome-blue armor and a fan-shaped layered metallic gown, set against cool blue holographic interfaces and transparent reactor columns; 2) center empress in glossy deep violet-purple armor-dress with black accents, set against glowing purple cylindrical machinery; 3) right empress in ivory-white and polished gold armor-gown, set against warm golden circuitry and a circular portal-like machine. Their dresses should look like futuristic couture made of overlapping shard plates, liquid metal, angular feathers, corset bodices, mechanical shoulder and arm details, and long floor-length trains. Background: dense high-tech chamber with robotic arms hanging from the ceiling, glass tubes, luminous rings, cables, metallic walls, hologram panels, and reflective black floor with neon light strips. Lighting should be cinematic and glossy with strong rim lights, blue on the left, purple in the center, gold on the right, intense specular reflections, volumetric glow, and a premium 3D anime illustration look. Use ultra-sharp focus, intricate details, symmetrical composition, dramatic vertical framing, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.
